data.title: Speeding fine (Bußgeldbescheid) from Zentrale Bußgeldbehörde Beispielsaarland
data.summary: The Zentrale Bußgeldbehörde Beispielsaarland issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) dated 20 November 2026 for speeding 27 km/h over the 70 km/h limit outside a built-up area on 29 September 2026. The total amount due is €182.00 and one point is recorded in the Fahreignungsregister; the notice was delivered on 21 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is an official fine for a traffic offence (speeding). You have a window to file a written objection (Einspruch) if you disagree — the app will show the deadline, counted from the day the letter was actually delivered to you. If you don't object, the fine becomes legally final and you must then pay the full €182.00 within two weeks of it becoming final, to the account shown. If you ignore it entirely, it can be enforced against you. Consider getting legal advice if you want to contest the facts, as this affects your driving record.

remedy.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Zentralen Bußgeldbehörde Beispielsaarland.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch)
items.action: Decide whether to file a written objection (Einspruch) with the Zentrale Bußgeldbehörde Beispielsaarland, or submit it to their record (zur Niederschrift), by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed, the fine becomes legally final (rechtskräftig) and can be enforced.
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Zentralen Bußgeldbehörde Beispielsaarland.

items.title: Pay the fine (Bußgeld) of €182.00
items.action: Once the notice has become legally final (i.e. no objection was filed or any objection was resolved), pay the total amount of €182.00 within two weeks to the stated account.
items.consequence: Unpaid fines after the notice is final can lead to enforcement measures.
items.quote: Zahlen Sie erst, wenn dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, und dann binnen zwei Wochen auf das Konto DE94 5901 0000 0006 6121 00.
